# Trimble Maps Account Manager API

- **Product:** Trimble Maps Account Manager API (Trimble Maps family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** Bearer token from POST /authenticate (Trimble Maps credentials). Declared security schemes: Bearer.
- **Access:** Trimble Maps account administrators and resellers.
- **To call it you would need:** Trimble Maps account-manager credentials for accounts-api.trimblemaps.com.
- **Documented servers:** `https://accounts-api.trimblemaps.com/api/v1`, `https://accounts-api.az.trimblemaps.com/api/v1`.
- **Definition:** [trimble-maps/account-manager-new](https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/api/account-manager-new.json) (Account Manager API, version 0.1.0). Documentation: https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/account-manager/account-manager-api/.
